name: Hairline concealer / powder
lead: Hairline concealers are tinted powders, sticks or cushion compacts brushed or dabbed along the hairline and part to mimic hair density and reduce contrast with the skin. They are a common cheap camouflage for recession and a thin part.
The effect lasts until washing, and application skill determines whether the result looks natural at close range. Research is mostly satisfaction surveys on camouflage products in general.

paras: Pigmented particles adhere to skin and hair and visually fill in the gaps, lowering the contrast between scalp and hair color. Some products add a wax or resin to resist sweat.

Safety is generally good, but pigments can stain pillows, transfer to hats and run in rain, and fragrance or dye allergies are possible. The products cover loss and do not treat it. Marketing claims of looking undetectable are optimistic at close range, and good color matching is important.
